entities.name: Tiridates III
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tiridates III, a notable figure in the history of Armenia, associated with Arsacid Armenia and Christianization (301–330). Preceded by Armenian Apostolic Church and Gregory the Illuminator consecrated as first Catholicos of Armenia. Their legacy influenced Invention of the Armenian Alphabet and Battle of Avarayr and Partition.
